name: labs/scopefoundry__hw_picam
title: Princeton Instruments PICam camera (ScopeFoundryHW.picam)
intro: Princeton Instruments PICam camera (ScopeFoundryHW.picam), adapted from scopefoundry/hw_picam. It reads `adc_speed`, `sensor_temperature_status` and `readout_stride`; sets `exposure_time`, `roi_x`, `roi_width`, `roi_x_binning` and 3 more; runs `capture`. `capture`: capture a single image from a named camera with a declared resolution and exposure and return an image artifact reference. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
